evidence: The thickness and density of the nanolaminates as well as their crystal structure were evaluated by X-ray reflectometry (XRR) and by grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) respectively, using a Philips X'Pert PRO X-ray diffractometer. Some films were evaluated by high-temperature X-ray diffractometry (HTXRD) between 100 and 1000 °C. The structures for electrical characterization were formed as planar Al/Ti/ZrO2–Er2O3/SiNx/Si/Al capacitors and measured at room temperature. The composition of ZrO2–Er2O3 films was analyzed using an Oxford INCA 350 energy dispersive X-ray microanalysis system connected to a Hitachi S-4800 field emission scanning electron microscope (SEM). Cross-section images of films grown on three-dimensional substrates were obtained from selected samples using a Dual Beam® equipment (FEI Company) Helios NanoLab 600 scanning electron microscope with focused ion beam (SEM-FIB). The surface roughness of the samples was studied by an atomic force microscope (AFM) Autoprobe CP (Veeco) in intermittent contact mode in air. Capacitance –voltage (C–V) curves were recorded using a HP4284A precision LCR-meter in a two-element series circuit mode. The current –voltage curves were measured with a Keithley 2400 Source Meter in the stair sweep voltage mode.
